title: From Contexts to Values: Context-Dependent Defeat in Abstract Argumentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In value-based argumentation, an audience's ordering of values decides which attacks succeed as defeats. In many settings the deciding factor is not the audience but the circumstances: the same attack may succeed at one procedural stage, or under one regulation, and fail at another. Context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), a model we recently introduced, capture this directly: one set of arguments, one attack relation, and a defeat function that switches each attack on or off per context, so every context induces an ordinary Dung framework. This raises a reduction question: is context genuinely new, or can one value assignment with per-context orderings reproduce the defeat function, collapsing the CDAF into a VAF? We present a polynomial-time decision procedure for this question and map the harder neighbouring problems, with upper bounds from NP to $\Sigma^p_3$. translated_title: 从语境到价值：抽象论证中的语境依赖性击败
translated_abstract: 在基于价值的论证中，受众对价值的排序决定了哪些攻击能够成功作为击败。在许多情境下，决定因素并非受众而是环境：同一攻击可能在某一程序阶段或某一法规下成功，而在另一情境下失败。我们最近引入的语境依赖论证框架（CDAFs）直接捕捉了这一现象：一组论证、一个攻击关系，以及一个根据语境切换每个攻击开关的击败函数，因此每个语境都诱导出一个普通的Dung框架。这引发了一个还原问题：语境是否真正新颖，还是带有逐语境排序的单一价值赋值能否重现击败函数，从而将CDAF压缩为VAF？我们针对此问题提出了一种多项式时间决策程序，并映射了更难的邻近问题，其上界从NP到Σ^p_3。我们还提供了经过验证的参考实现和一种度量。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多项式时间算法来判断语境依赖论证框架是否可还原为基于价值的论证框架，并解决了相关复杂性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a polynomial-time decision procedure to determine whether context-dependent argumentation frameworks can be reduced to value-based frameworks, along with complexity results for related problems.
